column3: Kuroneko Route · After School Encounter
...What is it?
I have something to talk to you about.
It seems that you have mustered up some enthusiasm... but it is still useless no matter how many times you say it.
I don't know if it'll be useless or not. Come on, accompany me for a bit.
Unfortunately, I don't have the time to talk to you.
You might not have stuff to talk about, but I have things I need to say to you.
...You're sure being forceful.
Isn't it useless if I don't do that to the current you?
So you're trying to twist my will with force?
Nothing of that sort, you just won't listen if I don't speak more forcefully.
After all, I have had some experience before.
...I see. However...
Then please try to make some time...
Going for a low profile this time? Do you think bowing your head and begging will work?
It's useless, your pride is worthless if you lower yourself just like that.
It's true that my pride is worthless, reducing myself to this. I know fully well about my own worthlessness.
But please! Listen to what I have to say!
...No, I have nothing to say to you.
In any case, don't interfere.
Interfere...? I'm just going to talk to you on the way home...
It's certainly a waste of time being forced to stay here. Fine, I'll go to the clubroom instead.
...Aren't you planning on going home?
...I just remembered I had something to do.
Then I'll accompany you.
...You do know that this will be hindering my goal, yes?
I'm also a member of the club. There's no problem, right?
...Certainly, you're indeed a member too. However, you do know paper members will only hinder other members of the club?
T-There shouldn't be any problem if I kept quiet, right?
You'll just be an eyesore if you stayed there, senpai.
Y-You don't have to say it like that...
So you just don't want to be with me?
It seems that you perceived that quite well. That's exactly what I feel.
...Am I really such a hindrance to you?
Absolutely. What do you want me to say this time to reject you?
...Anything will do, just say it.
All right, then I will.
You're a hindrance.
I'll say it as many times as necessary. To be entirely honest, you're being a pain.
Reflect on how your own actions can cause troubles for others.
How many rejections will it take for that low IQ brain of yours to understand?
Eh!? Eh?!
...You're being quite harsh.
That's because you've already done this.
I don't get it! I'm just worried about you!
Why are you rejecting me?!
Me! Not just me, Kirino too! Everyone too!
......You won't understand even if I were to say it.
You wouldn't know that!
Quiet. Drive these words into your skull. Stop following me around.
Don't say such a thing... Won't people naturally be concerned about someone they know if they were to act strange all of a sudden?
......Is that so?
Yes, wouldn't you be concerned too if someone you know acted strange?
It depends on the person. I make a distinction between friends and mere acquaintances.
I don't think we're complete strangers, right?
You're a friend who hangs out with us, and even came to my house to play, right?
...Even though that's true...
...I'm getting more worried the more you put it this way.
It's useless to worry, just accept it if the person in question says so.
That's why I said I'm getting more worried when you're acting like this!
*sigh*... Do you know what "None of your business" is?
...Is that how it is right now?
Yes, exactly.
*sigh*... Senpai, don't you get it even though I've said this much?
Yeah, I don't get it. I don't know what to say to get you to understand.
Then let me tell you, I wish you would give up.
Pestering isn't a form of expressing concern, do you get it?
That's what I'll do if I think it's required...
But, from what it seems, there's no choice but to pester you endlessly.
That's why...
....I got it already, this is the last time, so let me accompany you.
The last time? What are you talking about? To begin with, nothing has happened yet...
Do you really get it?
...Nope, I don't get it at all.
Oh really, then I'll put it across clearer, since it's tedious.
So it's better if you stop it.
...Tedious, you say... It's a setback even to me when you say that.
Then I'll say it a few more times, it's tedious.
Then as a last struggle being the tedious person, I'll just pester you all the way.
I won't let you escape anymore...
Wha-
